notes: Fixes the workspace layout so Starters, Randomizer, Color Studio, and Gradient Studio are real top-level browser-style tabs instead of collapsible panels in the left sidebar. A second top tab row now separates workspace navigation from the skin-document tabs: Editor, Starters, Randomizer, Color Studio, and Gradient Studio. Starters and Randomizer open full-width workspaces; loading or randomizing a skin returns to Editor and creates/uses a separate skin document tab. Color Studio is moved out of the sidebar into its own workspace. Keeps multi-skin document tabs, direct EXE installer, and all prior tools.
